Subject: Request: Sustaining Statement to Cover Post-Audit Period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Elena / AuroraMed security team,

Hope you’re well. We received your request via procurement for documentation covering the period after our latest SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2023-12-31). To support your compliance review, we can provide a short sustaining statement (bridge-style affirmation) that:  

- Confirms there have been no material changes to the controls covered in the report since 2023-12-31, or  
- Calls out specific mitigation steps for any limited exceptions and an evidence handoff plan.

Attached: SOC2_TypeII_2023-12-31.pdf (redacted) and a Bridge_Template_v2.docx we often use as a starting point.

Questions for you:  
1) Do you need an auditor-signed bridge letter or is a company-signed sustaining statement sufficient for procurement?
2) Who will sign on your side (procurement, security, legal)? We can accommodate DocuSign if you prefer.
3) Target turnaround (we can draft within 2 business days once scope is confirmed).

Next steps I propose: I’ll draft the sustaining statement and route to your signer for signature. If you need additional artifacts (control narratives, logs, KMS attestation), tell us which ones and we’ll prepare a short evidence list.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the quick reply and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side:  

- Procurement requires an official company-signed sustaining statement; auditor-signed bridge letters are preferred but not mandatory.
- Security (security@auroramed.com) will review the draft and confirm whether we need additional artifacts (e.g., KMS evidence, recent penetration test summary).
- For signatures: procurement will accept an authorized signatory from Redwood legal or the Compliance lead.

Can you also indicate whether any control exceptions were noted in the original 2023 report and whether those were remediated? If so, we’ll need the remediation dates and evidence references.

Timeline: Our procurement window closes next Friday (2027-03-26). Ideally we’d have a signed sustaining statement back by EOD 2027-03-25.

—Elena

Subject: Re: Request: Sustaining Statement to Cover Post-Audit Period (SOC 2 Type II)

Elena — thanks for the specifics. Quick answers below and a proposed plan.

1) Exceptions: The 2023 report included two minor control notes (low risk) related to offboarding documentation and a logging retention clarification. Both were remediated: offboarding process updated 2024-01-10 (ticket: OPS-4321) and logging retention policy published 2024-02-02 (policy id: LOG-Retention-v3). I’ll include those remediation dates and evidence pointers in the draft.

2) Signer: Would procurement accept a signature from our Head of Compliance (Rachel Kim)? She can sign via DocuSign the next business day. If you need a partner/auditor signature instead, let us know and we’ll explore that path (it takes longer).

3) Evidence: To keep the sustaining statement concise, I suggest attaching:  
- Control remediation summary (one-page)
- Links to the redacted SOC 2 report (attached)
- Optional: KMS attestation (if security flags key management as a risk)

Proposed timeline: We’ll produce a first draft by EOD 2027-03-23, send to your security team for review on 2027-03-24, and route for signature on 2027-03-24 (DocuSign). That meets your 03-25 deadline.

I’ve attached our Bridge_Template_v2.docx with placeholders filled. If procurement prefers a slightly different format, we can adapt.

Would you like a short call today to align? Happy to do a 15-minute sync.

Best,

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwood.com

Naomi — this looks good, thank you. Security reviewed the template and had two minor asks (add the remediation ticket ids inline and include a point of contact for follow-up). Both are small and you included the remediation dates already.

We confirm: signature from Head of Compliance (Rachel Kim) via DocuSign is acceptable. Procurement will prepare the PO once a signed sustaining statement is returned.

Requesting a one-week SLA for document turnaround: we’ll need the signed statement back by EOD 2027-03-31 if an auditor-signed bridge is required; otherwise your proposed timeline (signed by 03-24) is fine. Please proceed with the draft; security will flag anything substantive.

I’ll watch for the DocuSign envelope and confirm once procurement has the PO queued.

Thanks again — Elena
